r2-med-01.mechanism: parsePermissionTail(text, n) pure classifier: null text -> unavailable; any malformed JSONL line (incl. partial trailing write) -> invalid; else valid. Provenance flows AdapterInput.permissionsStatus -> vm.security.source -> securityLines headline: valid+0 denies = ARMED, valid+deny = ACTIVE, unavailable/invalid = UNKNOWN (never fabricated non-deny). Observed deny rows still listed as evidence when parseable.
invariants: valid empty source still renders ARMED
mixed valid+invalid degrades headline to UNKNOWN while preserving observed denies

r2-med-02.mechanism: armPermsWatcher() single-writer: watch() only invoked while permsWatcher === null. Missing dir at init or watcher error -> bounded re-arm timer (5000ms, one existsSync per attempt, no content reads) until dir appears. disposed flag + clearTimeout(rearmTimer) on onDispose; stale callbacks impossible.
invariants: exactly one logical watcher per lifecycle
